title: Toyota KL Landing Page
description: Toyota KL is a sleek and informative automotive website designed to showcase Toyota’s lineup and services in Kuala Lumpur. My role focused on developing a responsive frontend using modern web practices, ensuring smooth navigation and optimal performance across all devices. I worked on structuring clean, maintainable code and aligning the layout with Toyota’s brand aesthetics to create a professional, user-focused browsing experience. The result is a visually polished site that highlights Toyota’s offerings with clarity and style.
